name: 云雾蓝纯棉柔软面巾款
description: 纯棉面巾套图模版：绒圈细腻、柔软亲肤、浴室挂晾与多色选择

styleLock.backgroundSystem: misty light-blue wall #DCE4EE for hero and scene shots, warm beige #F5EFE6 for detail panels, clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight studio lighting, gentle window-light feel, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte painted wall, soft terry terry-loop fabric surfaces, light wood and ceramic bathroom props
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single amber accent
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for folded towels, upright hanging form for scene shots, consistent scale
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean home-textile bathroom visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty light-blue background #DCE4EE, warm beige panel #F5EFE6, deep navy text #2E3A50 and one amber-orange accent #F2A93B; bright soft daylight studio lighting with a gentle window-light feel, front-left key, soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end home textile photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底首图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, folded towel centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A neatly folded towel presented straight-on at eye-level, centered in the frame, full product visible with nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the folded stack. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 8K, commercial home-textile e-commerce quality. Negative: no hanging hooks, no paper band or woven label with visible text, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no props, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达柔软吸水的核心利益，承接首图点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, towel draped on the left half of the frame
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle highlight on the pile, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the upper right 35% reserved for headline copy
shots.textZone: upper-right headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with a short sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The towel shown at a slight 3/4 angle, draped on the left half of the frame with a few crisp water droplets resting on its surface to suggest absorbency. Soft front-left key light with a gentle highlight on the pile, soft contact shadow. Background misty light-blue #DCE4EE. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Generous negative space on the upper right 35% carries a headline reading 「{selling_point_1}」 and a small sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」. Negative: no invented absorbency percentages or test data, no water splash covering the product, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用绒圈纹理微距证明面料细腻与做工
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom parallel to the pile surface, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing loop texture, controlled highlight
shots.background: warm beige #F5EFE6 softly out of focus
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture itself is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the terry loop pile surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The camera sits parallel to the fabric surface as a macro shot with shallow depth of field, foreground loops sharp. Skimming side light from the right reveals the loop texture and fine fiber detail with a controlled highlight. Background warm beige #F5EFE6 softly out of focus. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace as the texture is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fiber counts or weight numbers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入真实浴室使用场景，营造清爽日常感
shots.camera: waist-height vantage gazing up toward a wall-mounted hook rack, towels read tall and airy
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the upper left, 5500K, soft plant-leaf shadow on the wall
shots.props: one green plant leaf entering the top corner, nothing covering the product
shots.whitespace: balanced breathing room around the hanging towels, no dedicated copy area
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} hanging on a slim wall-mounted metal hook rack in a bright bathroom. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The camera is placed at waist height gazing up toward the rack so the hanging towels read tall and airy. Soft morning window light from the upper left, 5500K, with a soft plant-leaf shadow falling on the wall and gentle contact shadows. Background misty light-blue painted wall #DCE4EE. Props: one green plant leaf entering the top corner, nothing covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with balanced breathing room around the towels, no dedicated copy area. Negative: no recognizable model face, no brand words or logos on any textile, no QR code, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered counter.

shots.intent: 左右对照放大普通毛巾掉毛痛点，突出本品绒面整齐
shots.camera: straight-on matched split screen, identical framing and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: soft even studio light identical on both panels, soft contact shadows
shots.productOccupancy: each towel fills 50-60% of its own panel
shots.whitespace: none, the two states fill their panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison split screen of {product}, two matched panels with identical straight-on framing, crop and lighting. Left panel: an ordinary towel with loose lint fibers and fuzzy stray threads drifting off its surface. Right panel: {product} with a dense, even, tidy pile surface and clean bound edges. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft even studio light on both panels, soft contact shadows. Background warm beige #F4EFE8 on both panels. Each towel fills 50-60% of its own panel, no extra whitespace inside the panels. Negative: no fabricated test results or numbers, no brand labels on either towel, no exaggerated shedding cloud, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 俯视平铺展示全部色板，让买家按色挑选
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree overhead flat lay, five folded towels in a staggered row
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, soft contact shadows, no dramatic direction
shots.props: small color label under each towel
shots.textZone: small color label under each of the five folded towels reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant flat lay of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Five folded towels arranged in a neat staggered row, photographed from directly above at a top-down 90-degree overhead angle. Even high-key flat lighting with soft contact shadows, no dramatic direction. Background pale blue-grey #E8EDF3. Colorways hex-pinned: red #C65F58, orange #E8955E, yellow #E9D9A6, green #9DBB8F, blue #5C7A99. The five towels together occupy 70-80% of the frame, no extra whitespace. A small label under each towel reads 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」. Negative: no color drift between label and towel, no invented size or weight numbers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 特写包边与缝线，消除做工与耐用疑虑
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile close-up on the folded hem, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft directional light from the upper left with a skimming quality across the hem, controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, the stitching is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product}, tight zoom on the bound edge and even stitch line of the folded hem. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The camera shoots a clean 90-degree side profile close-up with shallow depth of field, stitching in sharp focus. Soft directional light from the upper left with a skimming quality across the hem, controlled highlight, soft shadow. Background warm beige #F5EFE6. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace as the craft is the subject. Negative: no fake loose threads, no invented stitch counts, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no blurry subject.

shots.intent: 用结构化参数表消除规格疑虑，数值留白后期合成
shots.camera: straight-on front view, folded towel at the top, structured spec table below
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: clean structured spec table with blank value cells
shots.whitespace: none beyond the structured table margins
shots.textZone: spec table area with two row labels 「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」 and intentionally blank value cells for post compositing
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on front view: the folded towel sits at the upper area with a clean structured spec table below, carrying row labels 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」 plus four intentionally blank value cells reserved for post compositing. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background pure white #FFFFFF. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond the table margins. Negative: do NOT invent dimensions, weight, GSM, material percentages, certifications or care claims, no QR code, no membership badge, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以折叠堆叠组合感收口促单，引导下单
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle on a stack of three folded towels, top towel embroidery visible
shots.lighting: soft warm studio light from the front-left, soft contact shadows
shots.background: soft peach #F6E9DF with an amber-orange #F2A93B accent band at the bottom
shots.whitespace: none outside the bottom copy band
shots.textZone: bottom amber band with a short headline 「{selling_point_3}」 and a CTA button reading 「{callout_8}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A stack of three folded towels shown at a slight 3/4 angle with the top towel's small dotted embroidery detail visible, presented as a value set. Soft warm studio light from the front-left, soft contact shadows. Background soft peach #F6E9DF with one amber-orange #F2A93B accent band at the bottom carrying a short headline 「{selling_point_3}」 and a CTA button reading 「{callout_8}」. The product occupies 55-60% of the frame, no extra whitespace outside the copy band. Negative: no invented discount numbers or countdown timers, no return-policy or service promise badges, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1为灰白橘藏青四色毛巾挂于金属挂钩架、雾蓝墙面配绿叶与宣传语；屏2为特性卡片（不掉毛、做工精细、品质保障、柔软吸水）与纯棉角标；屏3-4为卖点卡片（活性染料、绿色环保、色彩柔雅、不伤肌肤）与洗脸场景标题，其中抑菌相关表述未采信；屏5为灰绿两色挂晾与拧干不费力、精梳工艺说明；屏6为不易掉毛、小巧轻便、折叠堆叠与底部深蓝服务条（退换承诺未采信）；屏7为参数表（品名为舒适柔软毛巾、材质标示纯棉、颜色为红橙黄绿蓝、洗护提示冷水漂洗），尺寸与克重数值被遮挡且存疑，一律不采信。品类判定依据：参数区品名为毛巾、洗脸用途文案、浴室挂钩场景与洗护说明，判定为家居日用/卫浴用品下的纯棉面巾，与源夹名无关。已剥离内容：会员招募角标与二维码、店铺字样与水印、原文案原句、退换与抑菌等未证实承诺，所有尺寸克重成分等数值改为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 或空白占位，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
